grounding_strategy: Each step's target is (role, name, nth): a live Playwright Locator via get_by_role(role, name=name, exact=True).nth(nth), matched in the same document order the accessibility tree reports elements in. nth disambiguates true duplicate (role, name) pairs. expected_target records the (method, path) resolved at discovery time, with any known parameter's recorded value templated back to {param_name} - it is a reviewer/drift-detection signal only, never authoritative: guardrails re-derive ground truth live from the DOM at replay time.
